title: Loud 60 Hz hum from the speaker
backstory: The game sounds fine but there is an annoying 60 Hz hum underneath everything. Gets worse when the game is idle.
visible_effect: WebAudio injects a 60 Hz tone into the test output; the audio-meta indicator shows 'fault: hum'
diagnosis_hint: Persistent 60 Hz hum usually means a dried electrolytic on the audio amplifier board. On Centipede, check C1 (100 µF, 16 V) on the audio PCB. Hum that appears on the oscilloscope output means it's upstream of the volume pot — look at the power supply filtering on the audio rail.
